title: G6/B5 C3G first-step solve-form decision packet and diagonal-candidate recheck (PROPOSED, not a decision)
claim_text: PROPOSED B5 solve-form observation only: on the pinned C3G first-step traces the discriminating solve difference is pair 2 / index 1 (1 ULP), residual and diagonal Selector2 match, direct division reproduces the mrdivide q, multiply-by-reciprocal reproduces the reference q, and the retained diagonal candidate matches the reference at that point. No owner option is chosen, B1 and B4 stay unfrozen, and G6/Full remain unaccepted.

target_mrdivide.role: current generated-source mrdivide / division-form first-step trace

diagonal_candidate.role: diagnostic-only uniform diagonal reciprocal-multiply first-step trace

division_vs_reference.role: recomputed first-step compare of run-05 vs mrdivide

diagonal_vs_reference.role: recomputed first-step compare of run-05 vs diagonal candidate

recheck.aligned_means: structure and binary64 values could be compared; not G6 or Full acceptance

owner_options.label: adopt diagonal branch
owner_options.summary: Keep the diagnostic uniform diagonal reciprocal-multiply branch as the candidate solve form for finite nonzero diagonal inertia.

owner_options.label: retain division and absorb one ULP through a separately approved budget
owner_options.summary: Keep the current generated division/mrdivide form and, if ever accepted, absorb this 1 ULP only through a separately derived and approved B1 budget.

owner_options.label: defer
owner_options.summary: Make no solve-form or budget change. #59, G6 and Full stay open.

must_not_be_inferred_from_this_record: that the owner adopted the diagonal branch
that the owner retained division and approved a 1 ULP budget
that a new same-source contract (B4) is frozen

per_option.adopt_diagonal_branch: This C3G first-step pair-2/index-1 1 ULP would no longer appear on the 13 mapped states if the candidate used the diagonal branch. That does not approve any of the 120 budgets, does not cover C0/C2G, the remaining 500 samples, or the 23 unmapped states, and does not authorize back-solving a budget from the vanished ULP.
per_option.retain_division_absorb_ulp: Absorbing the 1 ULP would require a separately derived and approved per-quantity B1 budget. This packet does not write, derive, or approve that budget, and forbids using the observed 1 ULP as the budget value.
per_option.defer: B1 remains unapproved. The existing same-source entry stays blocked for missing approved budgets.

per_option.adopt_diagonal_branch: The candidate arithmetic would differ from the current generated mrdivide body. A later B4 freeze would have to record whether the candidate includes this diagnostic branch. This packet does not freeze B4. Independent 11.8 same-source Sensor30[10] differences remain outside this branch.
per_option.retain_division_absorb_ulp: A later B4 freeze could keep the current division form. B4 is still not frozen here, and the entry still cannot run without approved B1 budgets.
per_option.defer: B4 remains unfrozen. No model change and no new contract are recorded.

non_claims: aligned means the supplied C3G first-step traces could be compared
identical residual and Selector2 do not prove reference solver internals
1 ULP does not exclude libm, unmapped states, or another evaluation order
the diagonal candidate is diagnostic-only and is not a production model change
this slice does not approve G6 budgets, freeze B4, close #59, or accept G6 or Full

scope_limits.module: docs and validation decision packet only
